notes: Lumen "Mag-Rail": no chain or tread, a magnetic rail: a navy track with cyan edge lines and four coil rings whose pulse climbs the rail (the on loop), a navy housing with a flywheel ring of four cyan segments spinning inside it, magenta pins. Damaged: a coil ring is dark and cracked, the flywheel stutters, arcs spit at the rail. Disabled: the rail split and dull, the flywheel stopped and cracked, every cyan line dead.
